answer: A buyer commissioning forecasts for a garden and nearby meadow issues a fresh random challenge to each approved sensor before a reading. Payment is tied to the sensor's signed challenge response, location proof, and one time slot; the ledger accepts only one claim for that evidence. If ten agent identities echo the same data, nine receive zero, while independent spot checks against neighboring devices penalize fabricated readings. More identities help only when the operator maintains additional real sensors producing distinct verified observations.
